definitions:
EXP-2026-10-07-v3-badnews-veto (registered in logs/experiments.jsonl before any outcome was computed).

Plain English: does skipping V3 picks whose company filed bad news in the 90 days before the list date do better than V3?
Arms (each drops names from V3's list, no refill):
  V3         live rule (v3_rule.picks)
  V3_BAD     minus bad news: default_insolvency, mgmt_exit, independent_director_exit, auditor_exit, suspension,
             order_cancel, delayed_results, strike_disruption (event_ledger, filed in the 90 calendar days up to the list
             date's 15:30 close)  — primary
  V3_SEV2    minus severity-2 only: default_insolvency, auditor_exit, suspension
  V3_BADREG  V3_BAD plus regulatory_action — diagnostic only, no verdict (its category settles only in late 2024)
Window: weekly entries from 2023-01-01; eras 2023-24 and 2025+ (CAGR of the NAV inside each era); phases 0-4.
Engine: sim_screen_rank_exit.run_exit(..., "E0"), 126-session hold. PASS (verdict arms vs V3) = CAGR higher in both eras,
full maxDD not worse by more than 2 pts, at phase 0 and in >= 4 of 5. One era of regime -> a pass is provisional.
Before any outcome: trust/data_ready.gate(). SGM_REPRO=1: log nothing. SGM_RERUN_TAG=<tag>: log -RERUN-<tag>.

columns.phases_beaten: phases where the arm beats V3
columns.PASS: verdict arms only; V3_BADREG is diagnostic
